name: Trident of Neptune
description: Throw the trident forward, reducing Aquatic Dominion's cooldown upon enemy impact. Critical hits cause Monstro Spawn to enter a berserk state, gaining increased Attack Speed.

name: Horn of Proteus
description: Summon Giganto to leap atop enemies within range, disabling their mobility abilities.

stats.RANGE: A cylindrical spell field with an inner circle radius of 3.5m, an outer circle radius of 9m, and a height of 3m

name: Wrath of the Seven Seas
description: Launch the trident forward to damage nearby enemies, then direct all Monstro Spawn to perform an enhanced attack on the nearest hit enemy. When the trident hits an enemy, Monstro Spawn enter a berserk state, gaining increased Attack Speed.

stats.CASTING: Arced projectile that generates a spell field upon impact

name: Blessing of the Deep
description: Summon a protective barrier while flying upwards.

name: Aquatic Dominion
description: Summon a Monstro Spawn that can autonomously attack enemies.

stats.CASTING: Arced Trajectory (Summon Monstro Spawn) - Direct Hit (Monstro Spawn)
stats.DAMAGE FALLOFF: Falloff begins at 20m, decreasing to 50% at 40m

name: Tide Fall
description: Hold {{#switch: {{{p|}}} | PC = Space | PS5 = File:PS5 Cross.png | Xbox = File:XboxSeriesX A.png |}} to fall slowly.

name: Tidal Dirge
description: Hela channels energy of the undead to empower Namor. When Namor strikes with his trident, a spectral water column erupts at the target area, slowing enemies hit. Whenever Hela or Namor assist in a KO, an invulnerable Undead Monstro spawns at the fallen enemy's position, automatically attacking the nearest foe for a short time before vanishing.

stats.INNER CIRCLE SPELL FIELD RANGE: A cylindrical spell field with a radius of 3m and a height of 13m
stats.OUTER CIRCLE SPELL FIELD RANGE: A cylindrical spell field with a radius of 6m and a height of 11m
stats.DAMAGE FALLOFF: Falloff begins at 20m, decreasing to 50% at 40m
